info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Facilities Site Operations Operational Action-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of operational actions related to banking facilities site operations. It allows businesses to initiate and manage various operational tasks crucial for maintaining site functionality and efficiency. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial service providers that rely on streamlined site operations. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can optimize their operational workflows and enhance service delivery to clients.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for a facility's site.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action related to site operations at a facility. It is intended for facility managers and operational teams to document and manage actions that need to be taken for effective site management.
